body: Nonstop travel between the US and Australia remains one of the most important long-haul markets across the Pacific. In 2026, four airlines provide nonstop links between the two countries, with 8,820 flights scheduled, 2,610,162 seats, and more than 18 billion available seat miles, according to the latest data from ch-aviation. Los Angeles, San Francisco and Dallas/Fort Worth provide the majority of connections, linking with Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane as the main Australian destinations.

Los Angeles–Sydney is the busiest route in the market, with the four carriers operating a combined 1,498 flights in 2026: Delta Air Lines with 418, United Airlines with 362, American Airlines with 365 and Qantas with 353. The four airlines operate a mix of Boeing 787-9, Airbus A350-900 and Airbus A380 aircraft on the route. Qantas provides 170,458 seats on Los Angeles–Sydney, the largest capacity of any single carrier on one route, while Delta's service records 860,862,747 available seat miles.

Each carrier's network has a different focus. American Airlines concentrates on Los Angeles–Sydney and Dallas/Fort Worth–Brisbane, with 365 and 135 flights respectively; Delta Air Lines operates from Los Angeles to Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane; Qantas serves the most US gateways — Los Angeles, San Francisco, Dallas/Fort Worth and Las Vegas — including 359 flights on Dallas/Fort Worth–Sydney; and United Airlines builds its network around San Francisco, with 443 flights on San Francisco–Sydney, the densest single-carrier route in the market. United's San Francisco–Adelaide service, with 44 flights and 11,308 seats, extends the network to South Australia, although recent reports suggest the services are far from full, leading to a reduction in flights for the rest of 2026.
en.summary: Four airlines operate nonstop between the US and Australia in 2026, with 8,820 flights and 2,610,162 seats scheduled; Los Angeles–Sydney is the busiest route, with 1,498 flights across the four carriers.

body: 美國與澳洲之間的直飛航線仍是跨太平洋最重要的長程市場之一，2026年由4家航空公司提供直飛服務，全年共排定8,820班，合計2,610,162個座位，超過180億可用座位英里。洛杉磯、舊金山與達拉斯—沃斯堡是主要的美國出發門戶，澳洲方面則以雪梨、墨爾本與布里斯本為主。根據ch-aviation的最新數據，市場由美國航空、達美航空、澳洲航空與聯合航空4家業者組成。

洛杉磯—雪梨是全市場最繁忙的航線，4家航空公司2026年合計飛航1,498班：達美航空418班、聯合航空362班、美國航空365班、澳洲航空353班；座位數分別為114,981、93,034、110,960與170,458個。4家業者在這條航線上使用波音787-9、空中巴士A350-900與A380執飛。澳洲航空在洛杉磯—雪梨航線提供170,458個座位，是單一業者在單一航線的最大運能；達美航空的洛杉磯—雪梨航線則有860,862,747可用座位英里。

各家業者的網路各有側重：美國航空以洛杉磯—雪梨與達拉斯—沃斯堡—布里斯本為主，全年分別飛航365班與135班；達美航空集中經營洛杉磯出發的雪梨、墨爾本與布里斯本航線；澳洲航空的美國門戶最多，涵蓋洛杉磯、舊金山、達拉斯—沃斯堡與拉斯維加斯，其中達拉斯—沃斯堡—雪梨全年359班；聯合航空則以舊金山為樞紐，舊金山—雪梨全年443班，是單一業者在美澳市場最密集的航線。聯合航空舊金山—阿得雷德航線全年僅44班、11,308個座位，是美澳市場的新興直飛選擇，但近期報導指出該航線載客率偏低，2026年餘下時間將減班。
zh.summary: 2026年美國—澳洲直飛市場由4家航空公司營運，共排定8,820班、2,610,162個座位；洛杉磯—雪梨是全市場最繁忙的航線，4家業者合計1,498班。
zh.title: 美澳航線總覽：2026年4家航空公司共飛8,820班，洛杉磯—雪梨最繁忙
